name: PaymentAccount
description: Operator payment account for Stripe Connect onboarding and payout status.

global.schema:
type PaymentAccountState {
  operatorId: PHID
  lastModified: DateTime
  stripeAccountId: String
  stripeChargesEnabled: Boolean!
  stripePayoutsEnabled: Boolean!
  stripeDetailsSubmitted: Boolean!
  stripeRequirementsCurrentlyDue: [String!]!
  stripeRequirementsDisabledReason: String
}
global.initialValue:
{
  "operatorId": null,
  "lastModified": null,
  "stripeAccountId": null,
  "stripeChargesEnabled": false,
  "stripePayoutsEnabled": false,
  "stripeDetailsSubmitted": false,
  "stripeRequirementsCurrentlyDue": [],
  "stripeRequirementsDisabledReason": null
}

modules.name: stripe
modules.description: Stripe Connect account linkage and onboarding status

operations.name: SET_OPERATOR
operations.description: Links the payment account to the operator's builder profile

errors.name: EmptyOperatorIdError
errors.description: Operator id is empty or whitespace-only

operations.name: CONNECT_STRIPE_ACCOUNT
operations.description: Links the payment account to a newly created Stripe connected account. Called once, immediately after accounts.create on the platform side.
operations.template: Links the payment account to a Stripe connected account

errors.name: EmptyStripeAccountIdError
errors.description: Stripe account ID is empty or whitespace-only

errors.name: StripeAccountAlreadyConnectedError
errors.description: A Stripe account is already connected to this payment account

operations.name: SYNC_STRIPE_ACCOUNT_STATUS
operations.description: Mirrors the latest account.updated Stripe webhook payload into the payment account (charges/payouts flags, requirements, disabled reason).
operations.schema:
input SyncStripeAccountStatusInput {
    chargesEnabled: Boolean!
    payoutsEnabled: Boolean!
    detailsSubmitted: Boolean!
    requirementsCurrentlyDue: [String!]!
    disabledReason: String
    lastModified: DateTime!
}
operations.template: Syncs Stripe account status fields from an account.updated webhook

errors.name: StripeAccountNotConnectedError
errors.description: Cannot sync status because no Stripe account is connected to this payment account
